proposer_change.change: In VOCABULARY, replace hardcoded artifact IDs with section titles ('Standing exposure' and 'Cause' for 'gross margin forecast', and 'Overall utilisation' and 'In brief' for 'gross margin') while avoiding all other commercial words across all 21 sections.
proposer_change.why: Round 11 champion train commercial_per_k is 2.358 against the 0.0 real reference, and Round 12 writer_notes showed that hardcoded artifact IDs miss the PDF when artifact numbering shifts across seeds.

writer_notes: Round 13 passed all hard qualification and retrieval gates on both train and holdout (zero violations) with four fresh writer subagents running from scratch.

Naming section titles (Standing exposure, Cause, Overall utilisation, and In brief) instead of hardcoded artifact IDs fixed the BM25 and TF-IDF retrieval gate across all seeds, improved train top_opener_share from 0.130 to 0.104, and cut holdout commercial_per_k from 6.298 to 2.815 (normalised holdout gain +5.393 vs Round 2).

However, without a sentence-length rule in QUALITY, the fresh writers wrote long compound sentences (24 to 28 words per sentence), which reduced train unique_sentences from 48.833 to 38.500 and increased train commercial_per_k from 2.257 to 2.763.
Therefore policies/writer/round-002.md remains the promoted champion policy.
